seed: Putting a title page in front of a recording is one move, at Next defaults with no flag set: pick the recording, double click a title page tile in the Library, and the page lands on V1 right before the clip, the clip moved later by the page's length, with a cross dissolve on the join between them instead of a fade baked into the title. The join is an edit point like any other: right-click it and Change Transition > Cube turns it into a cube, which plays as the page turns away into the recording; picked, Delete takes the transition off and leaves a straight cut, nothing moving. Last, with all of that undone, the Film Super tile dragged onto V1 says Insert there at 0:00, and let go it lands in front of the recording the same way, its join dissolving.

steps.comment: THE FIRST TEST: the recording picked, a double click on a title page tile by the pointer.

steps.control: Transition Title Page to Tutorial Sample

steps.note: THE FIRST TEST: with the recording picked, a double click on Keynote Section put the title page on V1 from 0:00 to 0:04, right before the recording, which moved along to start at 0:04 and plays whole. The join between them carries a cross dissolve, drawn as a band over the cut, and the title has no fade of its own

steps.comment: THE SECOND TEST: the join's right-click is about its transition.
steps.on: Transition Title Page to Tutorial Sample

steps.note: THE SECOND TEST: right-click on the join, Change Transition > Cube, and the page turns away on a cube into the recording, shown here part way through

steps.control: Transition Title Page to Tutorial Sample

steps.comment: THE THIRD TEST: pick the join by the pointer and press Delete.
steps.control: Transition Title Page to Tutorial Sample

steps.note: THE THIRD TEST: the join picked and Delete pressed, the cube is gone and it is a straight cut; the title still ends and the recording still starts at 0:04, nothing moved

steps.on: Edit point Title Page to Tutorial Sample

steps.note: Undo backs out the dip, the delete, the cube, and then the insert in ONE step: the title is gone and the recording is back at 0:00

THE FOURTH TEST: the Film Super tile held over the recording's own track at its start: the ghost says Insert on V1 at 0:00, with the insert bar at its start: it goes in front of the recording, pushing it along, not on a new track

steps.control: Transition Title Page to Tutorial Sample

steps.note: Let go, the page is on V1 from 0:00 to 0:04 in front of the recording, which moved along to 0:04, and the join between them dissolves
